facts.fact: The document is the text of Loi n° 2018-004 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities (the 'loi statistique'), adopted by the Senate on 2 March 2018 and the National Assembly on 12 March 2018, validated by the High Constitutional Court and promulgated on 18 April 2018.
